name: Fresh Canna Live Resin Infused Preroll | Strawberry Guava
description:
Crafted with high-quality hybrid flower and infused with terpene-rich live resin, this 1.2G pre-roll delivers amplified potency, enhanced flavor, and a slow, even burn. Designed for customers looking for a stronger, more flavorful smoking experience.

Strain: Watermelon Runtz (Hybrid)

Infusion: Live Resin (full-spectrum, terpene-forward)

Total Weight: 1.2g

Aroma: Sweet watermelon candy, tropical fruit, light creamy gas

Flavor: Juicy melon upfront with sugary candy notes and smooth diesel on the exhale

Effects: Balanced hybrid — uplifting cerebral buzz paired with relaxed body ease

Burn: Slow, even burn with enhanced potency from infusion
